currentPlan.nutritionStrategy: Use a simple constraint-aware meal pattern built around repeatable staples, explicit avoidance of known triggers, and higher-variety grocery options. Example structure: yogurt-free overnight oats or eggs for breakfast, rice or potatoes with lean protein and vegetables for lunch, and a repeatable dinner bowl built around easy staple ingredients.
